notes.title: Steel Sword Story S Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As we promised, the classic 2D side-scrolling action game Steel Sword Story has been upgraded and updated to Steel Sword Story S today!

The original version will remain playable after the update by selecting it in the Steam launcher.

*If you already owned the original game before the update but can't play the S version, please restart the Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/00f5735ae5c3eb58017f79fcc7fe92c01b6a8f00.png

Steam Trading Cards

We've also added Steam-exclusive trading cards and badges!
Try to collect all the Steam items by playing the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/de016ca5c7bebf8af54296b442ee00ff822b248e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/a4524d354ec58b4ab42ee377b1667df483242871.png

Price Adjustment

As previously announced, the price of the game has increased alongside the update, from $4.99 to $9.99.
If you already owned Steel Sword Story before the update, you can play both the original and the S version starting today.

Please enjoy the newly evolved action experience!

SSSS x PGMMV Bundle

Yhe project data for the original Steel Sword Story is included in the game folder, and it's still there after the update. If you're a Pixel Game Maker MV game developer, you could enjoy Steel Sword Story both as a game and as a project you can always open and reference whenever you want. 

Buy the game and its engine with these nice bundle deals!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40937/SSSS_x_PGMMV_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40938/MV/


For more details, please refer to the PLAYISM website.

notes.title: Steel Sword Story to be Updated to Steel Sword Story S on June 11!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Steel Sword Story, the classic 2D side-scrolling action game that came to Steam in 2019, will receive a major overhaul update on June 11, 2024, becoming Steel Sword Story S! The original version will remain playable after the update, and the price of the game will also change once the update has been rolled out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/00f5735ae5c3eb58017f79fcc7fe92c01b6a8f00.png

Major Update: Steel Sword Story S
The game now has twice the content, controls better, and is more accessible than ever. Please look forward to the new and evolved Steel Sword Story S!

■ Steel Sword Story S on Steam - Changes
New special moves such as Uppercut and Ground Slash!
The map is now twice as big, with brand new areas to explore!
New bosses, new mob enemies, and new items!
New story segments, mainly in the final stage, that reminisce events that happened in the past and reveal truths of the story untold in the original Steel Sword Story.
New Story Mode difficulty for players who might not be good at action games, but still want to enjoy the story until the end.
60fps for a smoother gameplay experience! (depending on your PC specifications)
Steam trading cards and badges to collect!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/cfc3d767e162637d0c94259c623a80332853062a.gif

Price Change
Please note that once the game has been updated on June 11, the price of the game will be increased from $4.99 to $9.99.
Those who have purchased the game before the update will be able to play both the original and S versions. If you're interested and still haven't played the original Steel Sword Story, now's your chance to get both versions at a lower price!

SSSS x PGMMV Bundle
Steel Sword Story was made in Pixel Game Maker MV, which is on sale for one week only!
From today (June 4), you can get PGMMV at 83% OFF!
You can also buy it bundled with Steel Sword Story, so buy it now before the price change for an even better deal!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40937/SSSS_x_PGMMV_Bundle/

notes.content:

Also, don't forget about the upcoming Pixel Game Maker MV Game Development Challenge!

notes.title: Steel Sword Story: Character Introduction Pt. 4 - Oh Snap! Monsters!
notes.content:
Hello players,

While Steel Sword Story is a compact, smaller-scale game, it's chock full of various monsters - all with their own movements and attacks they'll use to try to stop Azul on his journey.
Today we'll introduce some of said baddies!

■Dark Knight
Knights Rufus summoned from the demon world. They block Azul's path in the castle. The trick is to watch for their attacks. Take advantage of their tight defense and find an opening for a chance to win. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/1bf22ccffc0a4abbf21d960c1a820bf46a66da2c.gif

■Cobol
A tribe of small demons living in cave-like forts with the intelligence of a human child. Nonviolent by nature, they coexisted nicely with humans, until recently... Be careful of projectiles thrown from higher up. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/ef0f4a048cd27c0cd488127fcff54eb8df38f9a2.gif

■Mow
A boar or elephant-like beast. Get rammed by one of these heavy guys and you'll be in a world of pain. However, they are super reckless, so if you dodges their attacks, you may have a chance to fight back.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/e2e2c668efd9e7fe559db5f5ed06c07cc6257a41.gif

■Zom
The dead bodies of former citizens who were killed by Rufus's biological weapons. Nothing can be done to save these wandering souls, and all one can do is to destroy their bodies and free them from their eternal suffering.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/287c797b87e9ac5799820b5c6c2138d67b5b04b4.gif

■Helm
Puppet knights created by Rufus's soul-sealing magic. They look cute and kind of funny, but it's dangerous to underestimate the sheer volume of number of attacks and mass. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/36b05eba39975cf62731de1135b505667eeafd73.gif

■Wizom
Former court magicians who were fascinated by evil magic. Blue ones emit thunder, purple ones fire, and black ones dark magic. The trick to fighting them is to dodge and close the gap immediately.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/a3a68ea355381e378b9fc76c31860b5e588dd663.gif

■Octapo
A turban shell octopus. It jumps out when prey comes near. The blue ones spit red poison ink, so be careful. There are also rare species that crawl out of the water and walk on land in dark places such as caves.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/fd7f42f9fe5f436faa4d8d56fd1bd9328a4fae18.gif

■Crow
A large round bird that swoops down from the sky when finding prey. They are omnivorous and sometimes target humans. Due to their intelligence and dexterity, some of them grab rocks and drop them from the sky.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/f54c60596b6cd0e9f9fff7965f66c616026af0c6.gif

■Pom/Mother Pom
Earthworms with a red, fruity appearance. Many males cling to the female Mother Pom. They put more emphasis on survival as a group than on individuals, and when attacked, males self-destruct to protect females. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/d6dd3d3765c0189efb38f195289d00e75f86f1a3.gif

■Byob
Enormous viscous organisms that live beneath the earth. They scatter bubbles of highly acidic gastric juice to kill prey, and suck nutrients from the corpse using roots wriggling underground.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/08320094e182cc4a96b05c7451ad50970203d8fe.gif

Are YOU a bad enough dude to press on through the waves of monsters and make it all the way to the final boss?!

In the next and final post, we'll introduce some of the bosses as well!

notes.title: Steel Sword Story: Character Introduction Pt. 3 - Rich & Diverse NPCs!
notes.content:
Hello players,

Apart from the characters introduced in Pt. 2, Steel Sword Story has a bunch of other awesome characters as well.
Check out the game for yourself to witness their cute and quirky yet finely detailed little sprite movements!

■Marrone
Azul's horse, with whom he has shared joy and sorrow since he was a knight. She ran away from the kingdom to follow her exiled master.
Some of the horse guard, dissatisfied with the series of incidents, helped her out.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/92779bdefeb0975ad7c7f5b0d79e4385ee8c2698.gif

■Grigio
A burglar offering his skills to the highest bidder. Calls himself ""the most famous thief in the capital"". He never steals from the poor and does not harm others as a rule, and acts as though he's somehow a righteous thief.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/4440908f6af0d158c10334e6a19b13568f633e74.gif

■Beige
A poor merchant who suffered misfortune while stopping by the kingdom for business. He encountered Azul while making his escape, and the fact that he's able to continue operating in such a situation is pretty impressive.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/07bae53eee78cc3523d7b860e1b37bf61205024d.gif

■Groen
An eccentric merchant who escaped war by opening shop inside a cave. It is said that he did not notice the situation outside at all because he was always quiet to begin with.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/b1b7494b85afc81a5039dae80d1aeb09cf3fdd76.gif

■Verde
A Grass Mage who escaped disaster by collecting mana by the shore of a lake. She has a laid-back personality and often sings strange parody songs. Apparently gets her feelings hurt when called the ""Moss Mage"".

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/d07f3d7b016b52eb78b5aa34602bce99bb208e6a.gif

Next time we'll introduce the enemy characters! Don't miss it!

notes.title: Old-school 2D Side-scrolling Action Game Steel Sword Story Released!
notes.content:
Today we were finally able to release the Pixel Game Maker MV-created sword & sorcery action title Steel Sword Story!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/65a25c20662885c9be8f34c1a456bf0078161309.gif

Here we'd like to introduce you to some of the awesome characters you'll meet in the game.

■Azul Palan Brau
The story's hero. Former Aurum Kingdom Imperial Guard. A skilled young swordsman, he was wrongfully accused of a crime and exiled. Some say that it was his love for the princess that angered the king.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/94343aaacfaa66def62013b3a5774f0204a5af68.gif

■Prime Minister Rufus
The prime minister handling the daily affairs of Aurum Kingdom in place of King Ouro. His political skills, both externally and behind closed doors, are excellent, but his origins are a mystery.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/890f6a2d77fce7be45a133dca8d1599a7d98bae0.gif

■Rose
Princess of Aurum Kingdom. Against her father's wishes, she has fallen in love with Azul, the Imperial Guardsman who has been protecting her since childhood.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/619baf0c1dcf985065343b6c4136c7086637526e.gif

■Ouro III
King of Aurum Kingdom. Extremely strict, but not cruel. Somewhat naïve due to inheriting the throne in a time of peace, this naivete is taken advantage of by Rufus.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/6650cb78c35135ed4a8d76c5c6fd65268bfe528d.gif

■Minotus
Bull demons summoned from the demon world by Rufus. Their jump and squash attack is powerful enough to raise the ground. Be careful not to get hit by the flames they spit from their mouths.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/53accd0444bab5f46fee52c0999235482ac62b5e.gif

These are the guys and girls who will be appearing in the game and providing the story with its heart and soul.
We really just can't get over these painstakingly crafted pixel graphics, and we're sure you're gonna dig them, too!

We'll be back soon with more character introductions, so stay tuned!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/b943fe75446c7c65a2f43ab2888eee5c040196e2.gif

notes.title: Pixel Game Maker MV REMIX Game Jam - Winners!
notes.content:
After hosting the REMIX Game Jam and hosting community voting for the 3 finalists, we are excited to announce our two winners!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/e1b9ce84b33899c2e45646b276acd6bd062d0b5f.png

We want to take this moment to thank everyone for their efforts for joining in the week long Game Jam, and for submitting a great variety of games. We enjoyed playing through all your games, and it was a difficult choice to select the finalists. We hope that you will all continue to support Pixel Game Maker MV, and continue to take part in our future activities.

After allowing the community to choose one of the winners through community voting from the three finalists, the staff behind Pixel Game Maker MV got to choose the second winner. As promised, the two winners for our REMIX Game Jam will have their titles shown on the Pixel Game Maker MV booth at “BitSummit 7 Spirits”, scheduled to be held in June 2019.


And the winners are....

Community Choice: Hex Hunter by Name User	
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/7865d927f25995937caef8d066d9684a281222df.png

PGMMV Staff Comment:
The community’s voice was overwhelming: Hex Hunter is your favorite! A twin-stick game with some intriguing concepts, we hope to see it finished some day!


Pixel Game Maker MV Staff Choice: Explorer Thief by Kyle
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/0df504765d8719c025a137699adbe9b8b21622bd.png

PGMMV Staff Comment:
Based on the Explorer sample assets, we were quite pleased to see a stealth mechanic implemented in Pixel Game Maker MV! We hope that this project also gets continued!


Thank you again to everyone for submitting, and we look forward to more amazing games that you build in Pixel Game Maker MV!

notes.title: 24 hours left! Get your REMIX Game Jam submission in!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We hope that you are enjoying Pixel Game Maker MV and have been exploring the possibilities for game development this week. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/e1b9ce84b33899c2e45646b276acd6bd062d0b5f.png

We are more than excited to see all your exciting submissions for our REMIX Game Jam, which ends in 24 hours! 

Dive into the engine now and let your imaginations run free! 

For full details, please see our previous post. 
For Terms and Conditions, please check this post.

Get some inspiration: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NCgPEVLA7Fg


REMIX Game Jam

We took this opportunity to launch our very first Game Jam to encourage users everywhere to try their hand at video game creation. notes.title: Adding assets for "RTB ~Return To Base~" in Pixel Game Maker MV
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

From today onwards, a selection of materials from the upcoming sample game, "RTB ~Return to Base~", can be downloaded from the Official Pixel Game Maker MV website! 

https://tkool.jp/act/sample-games.html

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/a2a31ca1c8703ee22b6cf77983c6a199b60bdc95.png

"RTB ~ Return To Base ~" is a shooting game made in Pixel Game Maker MV, and is planned to be released as a sample game in the future. The first stage of the game is a side-scrolling shooter, with the second stage changing the game into a vertical-scrolling shooter. Lastly, stage 3 again changes into a side-scrolling platforming shooter. The purpose will be to show how to use Pixel Game Maker MV to blend together different genres into a single project.

Pixel Game Maker MV is also on sale right now for 20% off!
We hope that you look forward to the completion of this sample game and enjoy exploring the assets for use in creating your own game!
